reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a document page with a magnifying glass inside, universally understood as searching for a file or closely inspecting/auditing a document. It fits tasks centered on finding paperwork, proofreading manuscripts, or auditing contracts and logs, though it can be confused with generic document variants at tiny sizes.
